title: Kissed Mexican Corn Bake
description: A romantic twist on traditional Mexican street corn, featuring a smoky wood-fired baked flavor and a tangy, slightly fermented twist. Perfect for a low-sodium friendly dinner for two.

ingredients.name: wood-fired corn husks
ingredients.notes: Available at specialty grocery stores or online

ingredients.name: wood-fired baking chips
ingredients.notes: Available at specialty grocery stores or online

instructions: Preheat wood-fired grill or oven to 400°F (200°C).
Shuck the corn and soak the ears for 30 minutes in almond milk to start fermentation.
Wrap each ear of corn in a wood-fired corn husk, overlapping the husks slightly to prevent steam from escaping.
Place the wrapped corn on a baking sheet lined with wood-fired baking chips, leaving space between each ear for even cooking.
Drizzle the corn with olive oil and sprinkle with red pepper flakes if desired.
Transfer the baking sheet to the preheated grill or oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the corn is slightly charred and the husks are tender.
Garnish with grated lime zest and chopped cilantro before serving.
Remove and discard the husks, then serve the kissed corn hot and enjoy!
